title: Exceptional transport system adjunction law
statement: For the parameters and a datum d of [lem-sf-exceptional-ring-transport-core-data], at every field stage E the given integral operation adjunction equals the strict-system adjunction reconstructed through the two chosen equivalences, transported on the left along d.realizeF(E) inverse and on the right along d.realizeG(E) inverse. Here d.realizeG is the explicitly constructed canonical comparison, not an arbitrary isomorphism. The full Lean signature of exists_exceptional_transport_core_system_adjunction_law is unchanged.

proof.text: The repaired data record defines realizeG as the inverse of the unique comparison between the two right adjoints of the given integral left functor. Apply normalizedRealizeG_adjunction at every stage and package the family in Nonempty. The uniqueness calculation is completely proved and requires no other transport law.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_exceptional_transport_core_system_adjunction_law
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (c : Compactification f)
    (operation : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l, Operation.{u} l Ω X Y (s.stage l))
    (left : ∀ s : RingStage.{u} l,
      LeftRealization.{u} l Ω c s (operation s))
    (d : TransportCoreData l Ω D hl c operation left) :
    Nonempty (∀ E : FieldStage.{u} l,
      (operation (.integral E)).adjunction =
        ((PurReconstruction.realizedAdjunction (d.reconstruction E true).equivalence
          (d.reconstruction E false).equivalence (d.adjunction E)).ofNatIsoLeft
          (d.realizeF E).symm).ofNatIsoRight (d.realizeG E).symm)

old_proof.text: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: conjugation yields the adjunction equality only for the right-adjoint uniqueness comparison. The supplied TransportCoreData leaves realizeG independent of the adjunction and realizeF. The canonical-comparison node proves the exact iff and the normalized construction; the obstruction node proves that a nonidentity twist rules out the asserted law for every datum. Thus the original universal step is invalid as stated, and the unchanged theorem is not claimed proved.
